title: High-quality cabin and driving feel
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe a high-quality feel in the cabin, build, and driving experience, with a few complaints about paid high-beam assist and poor repair quality while many fragments remain too vague to classify.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the cabin, build, cockpit, seats, and driving feel as high quality.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain that high-beam assist costs extra and that one repair was done poorly.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews use brief or ambiguous phrases about something being high or complete, so the exact aspect and sentiment are unclear in several examples.

limitations: This topic mixes product quality impressions with service or repair comments and a feature-pricing complaint about high-beam assist.
Many undetermined fragments are too brief or vague to identify the exact aspect being discussed.
The examples are sampled and are not representative estimates of all reviews on this topic.
